sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/22 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 109 Cove View Campground and search/details for each of its 20 units, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel (Cove View: 'EW - Electric and Water Hookup Sites (001 EW - 016 EW) ... Electrical service is 20 and 30-amp'), read 2026-10-20; reservevaparks.com site details: all 16 E/W sites list 30-amp and water

values.note: Cove View: 16 electric/water sites, shaded and sunny, for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 38 ft; all gravel pull-through. Two vehicles per site, up to six people. Four yurts beside the loop. (The park's other campground, Lover's Leap, has 18 back-in sites to 50 ft with 50-amp; it is a separate entry.)

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel ('Cove View Campground - 16 electric-water hookup sites', 'RVs up to 38 feet', 'All sites are gravel pull-through') + reservevaparks.com search/details (16 E/W sites, Pull Through, vehicle length 38), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel ('A bathhouse with hot showers is at the entrance of the campground loop'; park amenities 'Dump Station', 'Camp Store/Gift Shop'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'All sites have electricity and water (EW) and are reserved by the site.' Reserve online or at 1-800-933-PARK; a late-arrivals box is outside the camp store. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/natural-tunnel (Camping) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable by site with a 14-night max and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12; season already manual and matches the park page). Added 30-amp electric (20/30) and water, 16 pull-through sites to 38 ft, showers, dump station, camp store. Laundry is at the Lover's Leap restroom, not Cove View, so not recorded here. Not stated: sewer, booking window or cutoff for this park, first-come policy.
